user.title: Connect to Able to Use
user.description: Enter your Able to Use email, password and Firebase project API key. See the setup guide for obtaining the project key from your copy of the Android app.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Able to Use
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in with the same Able account to resume control and status updates.

error.invalid_auth: Able rejected the sign-in. Check the email, password and project key

abort.already_configured: This Able account is already configured
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the Able account already configured for this entry
